Users who rely on ChatGPT for quick visual searches can now add photos to conversations more quickly with a new gesture. Here's how.

ChatGPT makes it easier to attach recent photos to conversations

Although the Visual Intelligence feature on iOS has been available for nearly two years, it still only works on newer iPhone models and is not available in every region.

For users who rely on ChatGPT for similar visual searches, attaching photos used to require tapping the plus button, then tapping "Photos," and then picking an image from the photo library.

Although this process isn't overly complicated, OpenAI this week made adding recent photos even quicker with a handy new gesture.

OpenAI's Adam Fry mentioned on X that users can now long-press the plus button on the left side of the prompt box to bring up the four most recent photos.

Users can then pick a photo to add to the conversation, and then ask a question or incorporate it into their prompt.

This new gesture was rolled out alongside several other ChatGPT improvements this week, including better awareness of the current time, faster loading and performance for long conversations on the web, and clearer interface prompts while waiting for a network connection.

Have you used AI for visual searches? Feel free to share in the comments.
